source.name: Central Pollution Control Board
source.via: CPCB CAAQMS live feed — airquality.cpcb.gov.in/caaqms/rss_feed (keyless XML, hourly)
source.returns: per-station, per-pollutant CPCB sub-indexes — the index itself, not concentrations

integrity.rule: our worst raw Avg sub-index vs CPCB's own <Air_Quality_Index> Value, ±1

source.fallback: data.gov.in mirror (resource 3b01bcb8) — used only when this feed fails its gates; never mixed

derivation: AQI read from CPCB's own published per-pollutant sub-indexes — this feed carries the index, not concentrations, and nothing here recomputes it. A station's AQI is its worst sub-index, and the headline reading is the WORST MONITOR of those reporting, named, not a city average. CPCB's own city figure is the mean of the stations and is carried separately as city_mean. Concentrations shown are implied back from the sub-index using the breakpoint table in "About National Air Quality Index", never measured.

time.note: cpcb_observed_ist is when the AIR was measured (CPCB’s own stamp, IST wall-clock text, never converted); swechha_checked_utc is when WE ASKED CPCB (UTC ISO). They are different clocks and different facts, and must never be swapped or mixed.

city_reading.method: worst monitor of those reporting, named — NOT a city average

city_mean.method: mean of station AQIs (unweighted; CPCB weights by 2km-grid population)
city_mean.role: cross-check against CPCB's published city figure — not the page reading

check.reason: The source served 13-11-2026 05:00:00, which is OLDER than the observation already published here (13-11-2026 06:00:00). An unattended job may not walk the site backward in time, so the earlier, fresher reading stands. This check itself succeeded.

crosscheck.source: CPCB daily AQI bulletin (cpcb.nic.in) — same publisher, same scale, same definition as our city_mean, so any gap is our bug, not a methodology difference
crosscheck.compared: our city_mean against CPCB's own published city figure — never the headline, which is the worst monitor and has no bulletin counterpart
